value.rationale: A motivated failure of weakened commutator rigidity becomes dimension-free norm rigidity under two simultaneous approximate defects, giving exact compactness for merely compact defects; the square-zero family proves the factor-norm hypothesis cannot be discarded. This is a structural boundary and uniform stability result across all C*-algebras, not a numerical or normalization check.
